## Icon Opacity

Make home screen **icons** and **labels** translucent and add a **colour overlay**, so your wallpaper shows through.

- Icon opacity slider
- Separate label opacity slider
- Colour overlay with its own opacity
- Live preview over your wallpaper in Settings
- Changes apply instantly, no respring
*Real screenshots: stock (left) and with Icon Opacity (right).*
